subject: Azure/GCP metering prerequisites and partner evidence for listing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@infrapulse.com>, Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Azure/GCP metering prerequisites and partner evidence for listing

Hi Emily / marketplace-ops,

Following up on our listing intake — we need to finalize SKU/entitlement mapping and the metering evidence for both Azure and GCP listings before the catalog review sprint next week.

Key asks:
- Share the canonical SKU mapping spreadsheet for GCP and Azure (meterIds, unitOfMeasure, pricing tiers).
- Confirm whether usage will be reported via metering API (Azure) and metering ingestion (GCP) or if we'll use aggregated hourly/subscription rollups.
- Provide evidence artifacts for security/compliance and billing: signed reseller agreement, sample meter payload, and any licensing doc that asserts entitlement enforcement.

I've attached a draft "sku_mapping.xlsx" and a short checklist "sls_conformity_checklist.pdf" with what marketplace teams typically request. Can you confirm what's missing and flag any blockers?

Internal FYI: Ben/Vivek — can you review the attached SKU mapping and call out any Redwood runtime constraints (e.g., per-token vs. hourly SKU split) by EOD Thursday so we can get this to InfraPulse for DocuSign?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sku_mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet), sls_conformity_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Emily Wu <emily.wu@infrapulse.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2029 14:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Azure/GCP metering prerequisites and partner evidence for listing

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — attaching our current SKU mapping (InfraPulse_SKU_export_20290304.xlsx) and a short note on how we plan to report usage.

We will:
- Push per-usage meter payloads to GCP's metering ingestion (one meterId per SKU / per-region).
- For Azure we'll use the marketplace metering service with usage events every 5 minutes; Azure also supports metering through Private Offers if desired.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Do you need SKU-level throttling or rate-limits applied at the Redwood gateway?
- For billing reconciliation, do you want monthly rollups or per-event logs?

I'll pause on DocuSign until we confirm entitlements and the final SKU spreadsheet.

Best,
Emily Wu
Partner Ops, InfraPulse
Attachments: InfraPulse_SKU_export_20290304.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Wu <emily.wu@infrapulse.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Mar 2029 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Azure/GCP metering prerequisites and partner evidence for listing

Kimberly / Vivek,

Quick read — flagged a few items on Emily's SKU file (see inline comments in Excel). High level notes:
- We should split SKUs into: "runtime-hourly" and "token-only" to support both subscription and usage billing. Our billing connector supports both; token-only needs KV cache label to be present in payload.
- For rate-limits: recommend a per-SKU default of 120 reqs/min with a burst to 300 for trusted partners; we can lower if marketplace policies require it.
- Reconciliation: monthly rollups are fine for billing; keep per-event logs for 90 days for dispute resolution.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly: confirm Redwood's canonical SKU taxonomy by Thursday.
2) Vivek: brief engineering on the KV-label requirement and supported payload schema (I'll add comments in the spreadsheet).
3) Emily: if InfraPulse can map meterIds to the "runtime-hourly" or "token-only" categories, we can produce a final SKU sheet to push to AWS/GCP.

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/4521/company/InfraPulse

-ben

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@infrapulse.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2029 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Azure/GCP metering prerequisites and partner evidence for listing

Thanks, everyone — summary and owners:

- InfraPulse to produce final SKU sheet with meterId -> entitlement category mapping (runtime-hourly | token-only) — owner: Emily (ETA: 2029-03-10).
- Redwood engineering (Vivek + Ben) to confirm payload schema and KV-label enforcement; Ben will add inline comments today.
- Laura to kick off procurement / legal with the draft reseller agreement once we have final SKU sheet (owner: laura_bennett) — please confirm if you need procurement intake forms from InfraPulse.
- Once all artifacts are in place we'll schedule a 30-minute gate call with AWS/GCP listing teams.

DocuSign: we'll need a signed reseller agreement ahead of catalog submission; Laura, can you prepare the DocuSign template? Link to draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcStubDraft
